description: Source code for the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 Message class, which provides static methods for handling HTTP messages such as serialization, parsing, and summarization.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Final class providing static utility methods for handling HTTP message objects, including serialization, summarization, parsing, and URI construction.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a MessageInterface object into a string representation of the HTTP message, including start line, headers, and body.

methods.name: bodySummary
methods.description: Returns a short, printable summary of the message body or null if not printable.

methods.name: rewindBody
methods.description: Rewinds the message body stream if needed, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses raw HTTP message string into an associative array with start-line, headers, and body.

methods.name: parseRequestUri
methods.description: Constructs a URI string from a path and headers, using the Host header if available.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP request message string into a Request object.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP response message string into a Response object.
